claims.quote: The ruby tetra, Axelrodia riesei, is a tiny characid known only from the upper Río Meta basin in Colombia, part of the Orinoco system.
Type locality is 'Upper Río Meta basin, east of Villavicencio, Colombia', and this species is currently known only from the upper Meta.
Axelrodia riesei has a very narrow natural distribution and can only be found in the basin of the Meta River, a left tributary of the Orinoco River, in Colombia, South America.
Tiny, brilliant ruby-red tetra from Colombia. Sexually mature at 1.5–2 cm (wild-collected animals); in aquaria up to 3 cm. Soft, acidic water (GH below 10 °dGH, pH 4.5–6.5), 20–26 °C.
The species is endemic to the upper Rio Meta region in Colombia.
